Hex appearance reference
========================

VibeMonitor's Hex theme is a native adaptation inspired by Monitor HEX.
Reference: https://github.com/8bitNull/monitor-theme-hex
Reference revision: 79cb4747d6f1c370808096c32e7112dbcd95b9e0
The reference palette informed themes.css. The original license follows.
